record.content: EBRPD describes six lakefront beaches, two chlorinated lagoons, two pools, and two bay beaches. Walk-ins at open facilities are first-come until capacity. Optional weekend/holiday registration is named only for Castle Rock/Diablo Foothills, Cull Canyon, and Don Castro; registered sessions cost $6 per person, limit each registration to five entrants, and run 11 AM-6 PM with water exit at 5:30 PM.
